create_SessionRecorder: create a SessionRecorder to track HITL session data with config, connection records, and episode indices
start_episode_SessionRecorder: call start_episode on SessionRecorder to begin recording a new episode with its metadata and user mapping
record_frame_SessionRecorder: call record_frame on SessionRecorder to log frame data for the current active episode
end_episode_SessionRecorder: call end_episode on SessionRecorder to finalize an episode with completion status and metrics
get_episode_outputs_SessionRecorder: call get_episode_outputs on SessionRecorder to retrieve all recorded episode data including frames and metrics
